text: ほんとうは　もう　わかって　おるのじゃが　なんどでも　たしかめたいんじゃ！

structure.jp: もう　わかって　おるのじゃが

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on now. おる is the old-man form of いる. わかって　おる = 'I know'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. たしかめたい = 'I want to check'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining yourself. Here の is shortened to ん and だ is old-man じゃ. たしかめたいんじゃ = 'the thing is, I want to check'.
